claim_limits: This is a controlled compiler microbenchmark.
Invocation p95 is not a serving latency percentile.
The eager execution is a correctness reference, not a performance competitor.
The no-break case gates drift validity and does not establish nested-break benefit.
No serving, model throughput, or model quality conclusion follows.

control_validity.failure_semantics: steady control drift blocks both routes; cold first-10 control drift blocks the startup route while leaving an otherwise qualified steady route eligible
control_validity.ratio_definition: enabled=0 latency divided by enabled=1 latency

decision.control_rule: no_break_depth4 steady median baseline/candidate ratio must be within [0.95, 1.05] for every seed on both routes; startup also requires its cold first-10 ratio within [0.95, 1.05] for every seed
decision.failure_semantics: INCONCLUSIVE retains the full raw matrix; the measurement gate, control-validity gate, capture qualification, or more than one did not pass, so no qualified optimization-win claim is supported
decision.startup_rule: observed minimum of four paired-seed cold-first-10 speedup ratios >= 1.10; candidate steady invocation p95 no more than 3% above baseline for every seed
decision.steady_rule: observed minimum of four paired-seed median speedup ratios >= 1.10; candidate invocation p95 <= baseline for every seed
decision.verdict_scope: predeclared performance thresholds, no-break control validity, and two-arm CUDA Graph capture qualification

metric_definition.p95: type-7 percentile over 100 synchronized host-timed invocations

paired_seed_summary.descriptive_statistic: geometric mean of four seed ratios

metric_definition.speedup_ratio: enabled=0 latency divided by enabled=1 latency
